newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants Hai Hong up on placement.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants Hai Hong up on placement.

text.p: Shares of China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd, the most actively traded stock by turnover on Friday, surged on anticipation of a possible asset injection after it announced a share placement, brokers said on Friday.

"Anticipation the company may use the capital raised from the placement to buy assets from its parent, which can result in a boost in asset value, fuelled buying interest," said a research manager at a local brokerage.
China Merchants Hai Hong shares were up HK$0.325 to HK$3.825 in afternoon trade. Volume was 116.30 million shares worth HK$394.86 million.

China Merchants Hai Hong said earlier on Friday it had agreed to issue 141.22 million new shares to its holding company China Merchants Union (BVI) Ltd, raising net proceeds of about HK$446.6 million for working capital and to fund future investment.
